rows.title: At-The-Market equity offering completed: ~$1.944B gross proceeds (29.3M shares) to fund the Iridium acquisition
rows.detail: Rocket Lab completed its ATM program, raising approximately $1.944 billion in gross proceeds through the issuance of 29.3 million shares, to fund cash payments under the pending Iridium acquisition (expected to close mid-2027).

rows.title: Iridium's existing $1.775B credit facility amended to permit the change of control (Rocket Lab USA parent guarantee)
rows.detail: Iridium amends its existing $1.775 billion credit facility to permit the change of control, as permanent financing backed by a parent guarantee from Rocket Lab USA.
